provider_binding_status: planned; generated only after audited OperationDefinition migration

semantics.count_unit: one registry action expression; pipe-separated alternatives remain one audited workflow entry
semantics.publication_rule: no entry is published until its source branch, input/output schema, route set and backend RBAC dependency pass contract tests
semantics.capability_resolution: after handler migration, every OperationDefinition reads exact permission predicates from backend-route-permissions.v1.json; Unclassified, unknown keys or audit mismatch fail generation
semantics.provider_binding_rule: each legacy entry is expanded into atomic OperationDefinition branches with shared handlers and route-trace fixtures, then bound only to same-risk, same-permission, same-external-effect provider tools
semantics.route_binding_rule: raw route call sites are migration evidence only; runtime dispatch uses shared_handler_ref plus an executable route_trace_fixture_ref, never a user-controlled URL/method/service
semantics.legacy_field_rule: entry fields route_contract and backend_capability are inventory provenance only; they never authorize publication or drive runtime generation
semantics.tenant_rule: club_id is mandatory for every authenticated domain call and is rechecked by the target backend
